whatIs.title: What is Musicdibs?
whatIs.description1: Musicdibs is the world's leading decentralized platform for registering intellectual property in the music sector, using cutting-edge blockchain technology.
whatIs.description2: Designed to protect the creations of all types of musical and audiovisual artists, Musicdibs guarantees the security and authenticity of works in more than 175 countries.
whatIs.description3: With an accessible and uninterrupted system, it allows contemporary creators to register their works permanently and without maintenance costs, ensuring the verification and defense of authorship in any jurisdiction adhering to the Berne Convention.
